notes.title: New Update allows imports from Hegemony Rome!
notes.content:
Update 3.3.5 is officially here! The update adds some major new modding features like hi-res maps and support for importing units from Hegemony Rome, plus a handful of interface and gameplay adjustments. Click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/308173/discussions/2/1470841715958476598/]here[/url] for all of the changes.

And, if you haven't already, check out the Steam workshop to see some of the amazing work the community has been doing, including the latest Classical World mod (CW4) that uses the new Hegemony Rome import feature in 3.3.5 (you'll need to own Hegemony Rome and have it installed for this to work).

I've also got to drop a quick plug for our newly announced adventure game [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/646010/Golem/]Golem![/url] It's quite a departure from Hegemony, but if it goes well it will open up a lot more options for a future Hegemony IV. So if you're up for something different, or know someone else who might be, please pass along the link.

And finally, we are also working on the next expansion for Hegemony III - it doesn't have an official release date yet but we're hoping to at least get a few details out in the coming weeks so stay tuned.

cheers,
The Longbow Team

notes.title: The Eagle King DLC Available Now
notes.content:
The first major content expansion for Hegemony III is here. The Eagle King goes back to the roots of the series with an all-new historical campaign following the Greek King Pyrrhus of Epirus and his wars against Rome and Carthage. It also includes an expanded map with the island of Sicily, a new invasion sandbox, a dozen new factions, all-new naval units, war elephants, and more.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/502010/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

Along with the new DLC, we've also released the third major update for the base game that includes expanded naval combat, new tutorials, and a lengthy list of minor changes that you can read about here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/308173/discussions/2/133257324788111090/

notes.title: Welcome Autumn Sale Players, New Workshop Blog & Update 4 News
notes.content:
Thanks and welcome to all the new players who picked up a copy of Hegemony III during last weekend's big Steam sale. We hope you enjoy the game and if you have any questions, comments or problems we'd love to hear from you over in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/308173/discussions/]community forums[/url].

And this goes for new and old players alike: if you enjoy the game please consider leaving a review on the game's [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/308173/]store page[/url]. It doesn't need to be fancy, but even a basic thumbs up helps us get noticed and helps us continue to support, update and expand the game.

It's also thursday, which means we've got a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=567972743]new mod[/url] and a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/-1/485624149151980891/?appid=308173]new modding blog[/url]. This week Chris demonstrates creating a new brigade by adding a light cavalry unit for the Illyric factions.

We know a lot of people have been asking about tutorials and blogs for the map editor and we will be getting to those really soon, but for now we're holding off until update 4 is ready because it includes some significant editor improvements that we want to be able to demonstrate.

Which segues nicely into a brief progress report on update 4: we're really close, but it's not quite ready yet. As always, we've got a ton of ideas for the game and we're trying to squeeze in as many of those into this update as possible. Right now we're working on a major overhaul of how the AIs fight each other in order to support more custom faction strategies, more diplomacy events, new ways for players to influence AI vs AI events, and more. We'll try to get more details out as soon as possible, but in the meantime feel free to post questions to the forums.

cheers and thanks,
The Longbow Team

notes.title: New Mods, Update 4 Preview, and Steam Sale!
notes.content:
Even though there's a lot going on with holidays and sales, it's still thursday and that means we've got a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/-1/485623406943553766/?appid=308173]new modding blog[/url] and a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=562481608]new mod[/url] for you guys to try. In this week's post Chris shows how to create a new faction skill that allows you to construct ships in every coastal city without needing to build shipyards first.

And if you haven't been following our modding blog, be sure to check out the previous posts and mods including the 'Famous Officer' mod that increases brigade size and the 'Resource Wintering' upgrade that boosts winter food production.

As most of you know, we're also busy preparing the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/308173/discussions/2/490125103628099220/]update 4 beta[/url] which includes an overhaul of the charging and ambush mechanics, new scout units, more diplomatic events, improved resource movement, and a lot more. For a small preview, check out our ambush demo over on YouTube:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJgcxkb13ow
And finally, Hegemony III is just $20 this weekend so there's never been a better time to pick it up for yourself or a friend!

notes.title: Update 3.0.3 is Available Now!
notes.content:
It's here! We can't believe it's been over a month since the last update, but #3 is now available and it's easily the biggest update yet. Thanks to everyone in the community who helped us balance and test it and please keep the feedback coming since we'll be jumping right into work on the next update.

For those who haven't been following the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/308173/discussions/2/483367798517205753/]beta[/url], 3.0.3 includes some major engine improvements, a complete overhaul of the opening objectives, balance adjustments to almost every unit, plus AI improvements, bug fixes and more.

Despite all of the changes, the update is intended to be backwards compatible so if you run into problems loading a saved game please let us know. And as always we welcome questions, bugs or comments in the forums or you can e-mail them directly to rob@longbowgames.com And, if for some reason you're having severe problems, the old version is still available in the 'Last Release' branch in the game's properties window.

And finally, this is the [b]last weekend for the loyalty discount![/b] So if you own Hegemony Rome or Gold but are still undecided about Hegemony III, you don't have much time left to get your 20% off.

cheers,
The Longbow Team

[h1]Change Log 3.0.3 Rev 36843[/h1]

[b]Engine[/b]
[list][*] longer zoom range on the 3D map
[*] longer zoom range on strategy map before miniatures fade out
[*] map now streamed from drive in 32 bit mode to reduce memory usage
[*] high detail settings now available in 32 bit mode
[*] fixed late-game performance bug with very large empires
[/list]

[b]Map[/b]
[list][*] more city construction animations
[*] fixed multiple incorrectly blocked map regions
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list][*] improvements to water shader
[*] improvements to strategy map transition
[*] new weapons for the Illyric units
[/list]

[b]Balance/Gameplay[/b]
[list][*] increased defenses for walled bridges, forts and cities
[*] adjusted units stats to increase difference between tiers i.e. spearmen to hoplite to legion
[*] standardized more unit sizes to make cost comparisons easier
[*] adjusted garrison size and defense stats for bridges, camps and cities
[*] battleline formations are now considered broken when a unit is out of food or crossing a ford
[*] significantly increased cost of colonists
[*] added initial gold costs for building upgrades
[*] units in battleline stance now press forward more to attack the enemy
[*] fixed bug with hastati ranged fire
[*] removed field range from factions who don't have archers
[*] Added Military Reform skill to unlock Hastati and Velites earlier
[*] added ranged attacks for later Sabellic units
[*] capturing one bridgehead of a ford will now automatically capture both
[*] bridge construction can now be paused and resumed
[*] adjustments to hegemony achievements
[*] brigade morale now drops gradually when you're out of gold in proportion to your deficit. When morale hits zero a brigade may disband or defect.
[/list]

[b]Interface/GUI[/b]
[list][*] improved display of garrison stats
[*] cleaned up how miniatures are drawn for groups
[*] fixed bug with group direction after dragging group formations
[*] added more information to colonize button tooltip
[*] victory screen is no longer displayed again if the game is continued
[*] fixed issue selecting units near forts/bridges
[*] added objective target markers to the strategy map
[*] completed sub-tasks no longer appear in the objective tracker
[*] added cancel objective button to the objective tracker
[*] added more diplomacy and faction skill information to the faction pedia page
[/list]

[b]AI[/b]
[list][*] ai puts more emphasis on building unit upgrade buildings
[*] improved ai use of skill points
[*] adjustments to when the ai builds forts and bridges
[*] fixed a few ai resource management bugs
[*] fixed bug that caused ai to downgrade stone walls to wood
[*] more emphasis on per-faction AI behaviour
[*] defeated factions will now start abandoning farms, forts and bridges
[/list]

[b]Objectives[/b]
[list][*] overhauled prelude objectives
[*] objectives are now triggered by visiting independent cities

notes.title: Update 3.0.3 is Available Now!
notes.content:
It's here! We can't believe it's been over a month since the last update, but #3 is now available and it's easily the biggest update yet. Thanks to everyone in the community who helped us balance and test it and please keep the feedback coming since we'll be jumping right into work on the next update.

For those who haven't been following the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/308173/discussions/2/483367798517205753/]beta[/url], 3.0.3 includes some major engine improvements, a complete overhaul of the opening objectives, balance adjustments to almost every unit, plus AI improvements, bug fixes and more.

Despite all of the changes, the update is intended to be backwards compatible so if you run into problems loading a saved game please let us know. And as always we welcome questions, bugs or comments in the forums or you can e-mail them directly to rob@longbowgames.com And, if for some reason you're having severe problems, the old version is still available in the 'Last Release' branch in the game's properties window.

And finally, this is the [b]last weekend for the loyalty discount![/b] So if you own Hegemony Rome or Gold but are still undecided about Hegemony III, you don't have much time left to get your 20% off.

cheers,
The Longbow Team

notes.title: Beta applicants and last day for portrait contest
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who sent in an application for beta testing over the weekend. The response was amazing and we'll try to get acceptance letters out by the end of the week. While we've likely got everyone we need now for the first round, we might still be able to squeeze a few more into round 2 so it's not too late to send in an application if you haven't already.

Similarly, it's not too late to submit your postings to the custom portrait contest.  We're still taking submissions until midnight EST tomorrow so dig up your old Hegemony reviews or let's plays and send them on over to rob@longbowgames.com and you could see yourself as a general in Hegemony III. 

And just to clarify a few issues that have been raised: the postings can be old or new, so whether you wrote a Philip of Macedon review 5 years ago or posted a Rome twitch video last night it's all great. And secondly, when we refer to sending a profile selfie, our artists are looking for a photo taken directly from the side where your face is in profile like the example portraits at the top of the contest page ( www.hegemony3.com/contest ). 

Cheers,
The Longbow Team

notes.title: Looking for Hegemony III Beta Testers!
notes.content:
Just in time for summer vacation we're looking for players to help us with the final play-testing and balancing of Hegemony III. All the cities and resources are on the map and we're just wrapping up the last units, but with the biggest and most dynamic Hegemony sandbox ever there's no way we can playtest everything as thoroughly as we want. So we're looking for players from the community who have the time and interest to help us playtest the game and give us feedback on bugs, AI, difficulty, balance, etc. 

If you're interested in participating, please send an e-mail to [b]rob@longbowgames.com[/b] with your steam name (not your login), machine specs (windows version, memory, video card, etc), gaming history and anything else you think is relevant to being a Hegemony playtester. We'll be sending out acceptance letters in about a week, but there are limited spaces available and all else being equal we will prioritize earlier applications.

notes.title: Hegemony III Portrait Contest!
notes.content:
Calling all generals! Share with us your tales of victory and conquest for a chance to win a custom portrait included in Hegemony III. Send us a link to your Hegemony Let's Plays, blogs, game diaries, after-action reports, fan art, reviews or other long-form posts and help us spread the word about Hegemony. Each player who submits a qualifying post along with a profile selfie and faction preference (Gallic, Roman, Etruscan or Greek) will be entered into a draw, and at the end of the month we'll randomly select half a dozen (6) entries to have a custom portrait drawn by Longbow artists to be included in the final release of Hegemony III.

Please read all of the [url=https://www.hegemony3.com/contest/]rules on our website[/url] before submitting an entry. The contest closes at 11:59PM EST on June 30th, 2015.
